gameDissections.evidenceSummary: In G09 (map=16, 956x873, land=423,950, 5 teams, t=14666), only 6/8 bots entered (dave_w blocked by Server 0 error 4577; noah88 silent). Worse, ethan21 (me=37) and ryan_m (me=33, logged as 'Redacted 8N') failed [Nope] tag verification in Room 0 and were placed on Team 3 while mark07/kevin_k/lucas94/leo_tx were on Team 2, AND pre-d590acd findVirtualSquadAnchor stranded 4 of 6 bots on tiny northern islands (leo_tx 1,286px, kevin_k 4,193px, ethan21 9,458px, ryan_m 13,657px). Because isTeammate(g,p) only checks g.teams[p]===g.teams[me], at t=2695..2806 ryan_m (Team 3) and lucas94 (Team 2) launched 7 sea-interception chase boats and land attacks at each other (burning 115,887 in-flight troops + ~42,000 boat/attack taxes), collapsing lucas94's density from 21.7 (365k bal) at t=2790 to 3.9 (77k bal) at t=3060 and ryan_m's from 23.5 (250k bal) to 3.7 (35k bal). With 0 squad-wide focus-fire coordination (0 HL-ASSIST events, P.focusBonus=1.0 disabled, maxTargets=6), Team 1 easily wiped out kevin_k (t=2012), mark07 (t=2085), ethan21 (t=3609), and ryan_m (t=3827), leaving lucas94 trapped in a 3,671px pocket at 150*L hard cap until t=14666 (place=3, 4,874px vs Team 1's 413,429px).

gameDissections.gameId: G08 (01:13 CST, V10 Cross-Game Multi-Front Audit)
gameDissections.evidenceSummary: In G08 (6 teams, 7 bots on main continent), V10 exhibited two opposite failures: (1) Simultaneous multi-team provocation—between t=3648 and t=3912, kevin_k, lucas94, and mark07 simultaneously opened fronts against 3 different enemy teams (enemy=2 SGX union, enemy=18 Turk, enemy=41 rubi); (2) Infinite 2-tick assist-poke machine-gun bug—because tryDonateToTeammate lacked a per-bot assist cooldown and page.js/headless-bot.mjs only updated hasAttack(me,q) after WebSocket server round-trip (~12-20 ticks), kevin_k (7x at t=3782..3794), lucas94 (5x at t=3800..3808, 7x at t=4314..4326), mark07 (8x at t=3898..3912), and ryan_m (7x at t=5322..5334) each machine-gunned 5~8 consecutive 10%B commands in 8~14 ticks, draining 44.7%~61.2% of their own troop balances per burst!

gameDissections.gameId: G03 & G04 (00:41 & 00:50 CST, V10 Assist-Burst Drain Audit)
gameDissections.evidenceSummary: Across G03 (32 HL-ASSIST commands in 5 bursts) and G04 (29 HL-ASSIST commands in 3 bursts), every single squad-rescue assist triggered a 5~14 shot machine-gun burst at 2-tick intervals (112ms). In G04 at t=5042..5060 and t=6594..6622, noah88 fired 10x10%B (draining 69.4% of his balance) and 14x10%B (draining 81.0% of his balance in 28 ticks!) at enemy=23 ([CN]), hollowing out Team 1's second-largest pillar right as Team 2 launched its counter-offensive.

variableEvaluations.currentValue: P.focusBonus=1.0 (disabled); P.maxTargets=6 (unlocked for juicy land); offers(g) gives only 0.82x/0.78x mild discount when clanAllyAtkers>0, does NOT subtract allyAtk from rawNeed, and has zero penalty against opening fronts on 2nd/3rd enemy teams; tryDonateToTeammate fires g.attack(102, mainAttacker) with NO local cooldown, causing 5~14x 10%B machine-gun bursts (45%~81% B self-drain) over 2-tick periods before server RTT updates g.hasAttack; isTeammate(g,p) ignores isOurSquadBot when a bot is Redacted into another team (causing G09 Team 2 vs Team 3 fratricide)
variableEvaluations.baseline80PctValue: Boss-centered cohesive wedge with P.period=5, P.maxTargets=3, oppFloorCap=128 (preventing reckless multi-front pokes and 2-tick RTT assist machine-gunning)
variableEvaluations.recommendedOptimalValue: 1) Deterministic 8-brother Focus-Fire Target & Team Lock in offers(g): subtract 0.85*allyAtk from rawNeed, apply c*=0.58 / rankMult*=0.52 when >=1 squad brother is attacking q (or 0.48x when >=2 brothers), and apply a 1.45x multi-team war penalty (c*=1.45) against opening new fronts on unengaged enemy teams while any squad brother is in active human war; 2) Activate P.focusBonus=0.78 and restore P.maxTargets=3; 3) Add strict 90-tick cooldown (this.lastAssistTick) on squad-rescue/boss-assist pokes so 10%B assist fires exactly ONCE per rescue instead of 5~14x machine-gun bursts; 4) Include this.isOurSquadBot(g,p) in non-aggression & sea-interception filters to prevent fratricide if a bot is Redacted
variableEvaluations.causalMechanism: In 5~6 team autonomous matches without a human Boss, 8 bots lack a shared target selector: (1) P.focusBonus=1.0 and P.maxTargets=6 allow adjacent brothers to attack 3~4 different enemy teams simultaneously, triggering multi-team dogpiles against our squad at t=3500~5500; (2) When brothers do share a target q, offers(g) computes rawNeed = elimCost(q) + inAtk - myAtk without subtracting teammate in-flight troops allyAtk, so brothers either fail the budget check individually or mildly discount c*=0.82 without synchronizing a lethal kill; (3) When tryDonateToTeammate triggers a 10%B squad-rescue poke, P.period=2 (112ms) re-fires g.attack(102) every 2 ticks during the ~15-tick WebSocket RTT before g.hasAttack(me,mainAttacker) turns true, turning a '10% light assist' into an 18-burst, 125-command self-liquidation across G01~G08 (draining 50%~81% B per bot); (4) When a bot fails Room 0 name verification ('Redacted'), isTeammate(g,p) returns false and brothers intercept each other's boats and wipe each other out (G09 t=2695..3060).

topCoreVariableRanking.oneLineReason: oppFloorCap=38 + collapseFloorCap=16 + totB=B+myOut + prime keep<=10~26*L stripped frontline home density down to d=3.9~25, causing midgame leads in G01, G04, G06, G08 to collapse under enemy counter-attacks.

Zero team-level focus-fire lock (focusBonus=1.0, maxTargets=6, unsubtracted allyAtk), 2-tick RTT assist machine-gunning (125 pokes draining 50%~81% B per burst), and Redacted cross-team fratricide (G09 t=2695..3060) destroyed squad synergy.
Pre-d590acd VirtualSquadAnchor landed on tiny islands/peninsulas in Boss-less matches (stranding 4/6 bots on northern islands in G09 and 6/8 bots in G02/G05).
pct=51 (5% B) micro-donations paid a flat 6.25% B engine tax (55.2% loss rate across 382 donations) while starving boxed-in rear bots before t=1500.
Server 0 error 4577 and unverified 'Redacted' names reduced active [Nope] bots to 6 in G09 (splitting them 4v2 across Team 2 and Team 3) and 7 in G08.
Tightening allyMinSep<=112 and clusterMax<=350 compressed the squad into a small basin and triggered voronoi=500 fallbacks when crowded.
Sea interception allowed up to 35% B per chase boat (e.g. G09 lucas94 burning 35.0% B at t=9120 and ryan_m burning 38.7% B across t=2695..2806).
